title: TaskCommand
responsibility: Audits the declared coding or planning task through the shared completion service and renders its persisted result.

inputs.name: TaskCommand.constructor.root
inputs.description: Project filesystem root used to read committed source, loop metadata or verification evidence.

inputs.name: TaskCommand.run.flags
inputs.description: Task kind, goal, plan, loop and optional registered-unit selection supplied by the CLI.

inputs.name: registerTaskCommand.program
inputs.description: Commander program on which the task check subcommand is registered.

inputs.name: renderTaskAudit.audit
inputs.description: Persisted task checks and semantic limitation to render as human-readable CLI output.

outputs.name: TaskCommand.run
outputs.description: Stored audit of the selected committed loop contract or explicit task flags.

outputs.name: registerTaskCommand
outputs.description: Registers CLI handlers; running a failed audit sets a nonzero process exit status.

outputs.name: renderTaskAudit
outputs.description: Human-readable outcome with every check, the semantic limitation and audit ID.
